notablePrerequisites: Demonmail Hauberk attached to Crookshank Kobolds.
description:
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds, targeting Phyrexian Walker.
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Koll triggers, returning Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Phyrexian Walker.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds by paying {0}.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk's equip ability by sacrificing Phyrexian Walker, targeting Crookshank Kobolds.
When Phyrexian Walker dies, Koll triggers, returning Phyrexian Walker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Crookshank Kobolds.
Cast Phyrexian Walker by paying {0}.
Repeat.
